messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: NOTICE: Org 'northforge' exceeding per-org token/sec threshold on /v1/chat.stream. Automated soft-throttle applied. Elevated error-rate and connection churn detected. Thread created.
leo (oncall): acked. looking at spikes and recent deploys.
nana: i see a sudden jump in active streams from 120 -> 900 in ~6m. client_ip clusters consistent with northforge CID range.
support-julie: NorthForge reports many users seeing 429s and websocket disconnects; they just kicked off a broad feature ramp 8m ago.
eng-runtime-sahil: confirmed: per-org limiter triggered -- org cap 250rps; current effective throughput ~180rps due to queueing, dropped requests rising.
leo (oncall): quick mitigation options:
  - short-lived per-org rate increase (10-20m) to avoid mass reconnects
  - enable session-grace (allow existing sessions extra tokens)
  - apply per-route deny for /v1/chat.long-payload if observed
  - swap streaming -> non-streaming fallback for low-priority calls
  - ask CS to pause their rollout
cs-tyler: i'm on with NorthForge, asking them to pause. they're cooperative but want minimal disruption.
infra-jen: what's cluster capacity? any risk of noisy org draining shared pools?
eng-runtime-sahil: GPUs at ~75% across pool; short boost should be safe. watching KV cache and memory.
leo (oncall): ok ana, please perform temporary override for 20m and add a note in audit. do not exceed 600rps.
ana: executing admin call now.
nana: ```bash
# temp increase to 600rps for northforge (20m)
curl -X POST "https://internal.admin.redwood/v1/orgs/northforge/overrides" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"rate_limit_rps":"600","expires_in":"20m","reason":"emergency - client rollout spike"}'
```
incident-bot: Override created ovr-8c9f by ana. Audit entry added.
eng-runtime-sahil: Deploying a lightweight routing rule to divert non-critical streaming to non-streamed path and to gpt-lite for this org.
eng-runtime-sahil: ```json
{"org":"northforge","route":"/v1/chat.stream","condition":"user_agent !~ \"mobile-sdk\"","model_override":"gpt-lite-v1"}
```
support-julie: relaying to customer: temporary cap lift applied, please hold rollout for 30m.
leo (oncall): metrics update: rps rose to ~520, 429s dropped ~90% within 2m, p95 latency from 750ms -> 210ms. connection churn decreased.
infra-jen: setting temporary monitor for backend queue depth > 200.
infra-jen: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal.monitoring.redwood/v1/alerts" -H "Authorization: Bearer $MON" -d '{"name":"northforge-backlog","expr":"queue_depth{org=\"northforge\"}>200","for":"1m"}'
```
incident-bot: Alert created: northforge-backlog.
cs-tyler: NorthForge confirms pause of rollout. they're requesting a short window to run smoke tests.
leo (oncall): agree to allow smoke test window but no further ramp. ops will monitor. handoff in 10m to infra-jen. leave override expiry at 20m for now.
infra-jen: taking watch. will extend only if stable for two check-ins.
nana: extended override to 40m after verbal confirmation from CS (audit updated).
incident-bot: Override ovr-8c9f extended to +40m.
eng-runtime-sahil: removed model override for mobile-sdk user_agent so mobile clients remain on default path.
leo (oncall): 12m update: errors ~0.4%, p95 190ms, active streams 260. good so far.
infra-jen: 22m update: traffic trending down, queue depth normal. preparing to revoke override at expiry unless CS requests keep.
cs-tyler: NorthForge requests we keep behavior until EOD for safety; asking for a follow-up call to discuss staged ramp policies.
leo (oncall): we should not leave long-lived overrides; extend to EOD only if we create temporary SLO guardrails. for now extend to 2h and schedule postmortem.
infra-jen: extending override to 2h via admin.
infra-jen: ```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://internal.admin.redwood/v1/overrides/ovr-8c9f" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"expires_in":"2h","note":"customer requested extended window; will follow up with control safeguards"}'
```
incident-bot: Override ovr-8c9f extended, expiry updated. Audit recorded.
leo (oncall): action items: 1) create INC ticket and postmortem (owner infra-jen) 2) recommend client-side preflight for large ramps 3) evaluate adding ramp protection to per-org limiter 4) CS to run follow-up with NorthForge 5) avoid long-lived manual overrides without SLOs.
infra-jen: created INC ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1934. assigned postmortem to eng-runtime-sahil.
support-julie: NorthForge appreciates quick response. they will schedule follow-up.
leo (oncall): closing active paging. infra-jen will monitor and post updates here; reopen if any regression. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
infra-jen: 45m check: stable; p95 160ms, errors 0.1%. leaving extended watch.
eng-runtime-sahil: prepared a config PR to add a safe-guard that caps short-lived overrides to max 1k rps and requires automated queue checks before allowing >500rps. will link PR in INC-1934.
cs-tyler: sending final summary to NorthForge now.
incident-bot: Thread closed by leo (oncall). Audit: incident resolved.
